notes.title: Zombie Tower Survivor – Demo Update for Debut Festival 2025
notes.content:
[p]Zombie Tower Survivor is featured in Debut Festival 2025! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve released a demo update to celebrate, with new content, quality-of-life improvements, and balance tweaks.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s new in the demo v0.4.1.0:[/h3][list][*][p]Game settings menu, including fullscreen/windowed toggle and more[/p][/*][*][p]Custom spawn speed to control how fast enemies appear (replaced the option for adjusting game speed)[/p][/*][*][p]New Aspect: Hippo[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial part 1 for new players (someone cute and fluffy will be there to help 😉)[/p][/*][*][p]DoT & Penetration talent rebalance[/p][/*][*][p]Tower level preview in shop[/p][/*][*][p]Real-time updates of stats[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes, such as infinite rerolls in the shop and achievements not saving correctly[/p][/*][*][p]...and other under-the-hood improvements[/p][/*][/list][h3]Try out the updated demo: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3476900/Zombie_Tower_Survivor_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p]If you enjoy Zombie Tower Survivor, please leave a review and wishlist the game! It helps a ton. 🧟[/p]

notes.title: Demo is here! Play Zombie Tower Survivor now!
notes.content:
The demo for Zombie Tower Survivor is now live on Steam as part of the Zombies vs Vampires Fest 2025!

Step into a tower-defense roguelite where you fend off endless waves of zombies using customizable builds with powerful talents and upgrades.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3476900/Zombie_Tower_Survivor_Demo/]Download the Demo[/url]

[previewyoutube=SipNrmK0xPA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What’s new in the Steam demo?[/b]

If you played the early version on itch.io, this updated demo brings new content and improvements:

- Achievements that unlock new upgrades and talents
- Progression system – unlock new aspects by beating difficulties
- Gamepad and Steam Deck support
- Multi-upgrades & multi-talents for deeper build variety
- Talent rewards for leveling up your tower and abilities
- New Archmage Aspect
- Major balance improvements
- New custom cursor and more

[b]Coming soon to the demo:[/b]

- Tutorial for new players
- Additional language support

Leave a review for the demo on Steam. Or drop by the Community Hub or [url=https://discord.com/invite/YDUNFPsy4r]join Discord[/url] to share feedback!

And don’t forget to wishlist the game on the main page if you enjoy it!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2934480/Zombie_Tower_Survivor/]Wishlist Zombie Tower Survivor[/url]
